name: provider-model-refresh-identity
prompt: Operate inside the existing control-plane chatbot identity container. Use its own 3tchedFS lungs at /opt/run-mounts/3tched. Read the sealed input schema at /opt/run-mounts/3tched/plugins/model_registry/operations/refresh/input.schema.json, then write the complete JSON object {} to /opt/run-mounts/3tched/plugins/model_registry/operations/refresh/call. Read the sibling error and result files; report a nonempty error as failure. This operation asks enabled providers for their model lists and persists their results through the admitted backend. Read fresh model_registry lookup state through the same identity filesystem to confirm the refresh revision and visible provider failures. provider_id is the stable Cozo key used for provider lookup, refresh and model pagination; never replace it with native_provider_id, a router family or a display name. native_provider_id and control_plane_profile are separate routing bindings. inference_url_prefix identifies the provider platform: the owner's OpenCode Go subscription uses /zen/go, not Zen pay-as-you-go /zen/v1. Do not infer bindings from model names or substitute Zen for Go. Report missing bindings; keep failed providers' last good model data. Do not edit database files or credentials. Do not make an inference request or change provider profiles. If the identity filesystem or call path is unavailable, fail with that diagnostic instead of switching to a host or external transport.
